summary.goal_reached: {{household}} have already reached their {{targetAmount}} goal, with {{currentBalance}} saved.
summary.no_contribution: {{household}} have saved {{currentBalance}} toward their {{targetAmount}} goal, but no monthly contribution is being made at present. Without contributions, the balance would stay at {{currentBalance}} by {{targetDate}}, which is {{projectedShortfall}} short of the goal.
summary.behind_declining: {{household}}'s savings contributions have been declining. At the current pace of {{monthlySavingsContribution}} a month, they would reach {{projectedBalance}} by {{targetDate}}, which is {{projectedShortfall}} short of the {{targetAmount}} goal.
summary.behind: {{household}} have saved {{currentBalance}} toward their {{targetAmount}} goal. At the current pace of {{monthlySavingsContribution}} a month, they would reach {{projectedBalance}} by {{targetDate}}, which is {{projectedShortfall}} short.
summary.on_track: {{household}} have saved {{currentBalance}} toward their {{targetAmount}} goal. At the current pace of {{monthlySavingsContribution}} a month, they are on track to reach the goal by {{targetDate}}.

consistency.no_history: No monthly saving history was provided, so consistency could not be assessed.
consistency.never_met: No tracked month met the planned contribution of {{plannedMonthly}}. Contributions averaged {{averageActualMonthly}} a month over {{monthsTracked}} months, which is {{shortfallVsPlan}} below the plan.
consistency.all_met: Every tracked month met the planned contribution of {{plannedMonthly}}, over {{monthsTracked}} months.
consistency.some_met: {{monthsMetPlan}} of {{monthsTracked}} tracked months met the planned contribution of {{plannedMonthly}}. Contributions averaged {{averageActualMonthly}} a month.

consistencyExtras.declining: Contributions fell from an average of {{earlierAverage}} earlier to {{recentAverage}} more recently.
consistencyExtras.improving: Contributions rose from an average of {{earlierAverage}} earlier to {{recentAverage}} more recently.
consistencyExtras.steady: Contributions have been steady across the tracked months.

spending.normal: Monthly expenses take {{expenseSharePercent}}% of income, leaving {{incomeAfterExpenses}} a month after expenses.
spending.no_expenses: No monthly expenses were provided, so spending could not be assessed.
spending.over_income: Monthly expenses of {{monthlyExpenses}} are higher than monthly income of {{monthlyIncome}}, so there is nothing left to save without reducing spending.

progress.goal_reached: {{currentBalance}} is saved against a {{targetAmount}} target, so the goal has been reached.
progress.behind: {{percentComplete}}% of the {{targetAmount}} target is saved ({{currentBalance}}). At the current pace the balance would reach {{projectedBalance}} by {{targetDate}}, which is {{projectedShortfall}} short of the goal.
progress.on_track: {{percentComplete}}% of the {{targetAmount}} target is saved ({{currentBalance}}). At the current pace the balance would reach {{projectedBalance}} by {{targetDate}}, enough to meet the goal.

closeGap.title: Close the monthly gap
closeGap.description: Saving {{requiredMonthly}} a month, which is {{monthlyGap}} more than now, would reach the target by {{targetDate}}. That is about {{requiredShare}}% of monthly income.

recommendations.closeGapMissed: If a month is missed, the amount needed each month rises to {{newRequiredMonthly}}.

keepGoing.title: Keep the current routine
keepGoing.description: Continue saving {{monthlySavingsContribution}} a month and record each contribution as it is made.

nextStep.title: Plan the next step
nextStep.description: The target has been reached. Consider setting a new goal, or confirm that this one is complete.

automate.title: Make saving automatic
automate.description: Set up a recurring transfer or reminder for the day income arrives, so every month meets the plan.

reviewSpending.title: Review monthly spending
reviewSpending.description: Look through recurring expenses, which take {{expenseSharePercent}}% of income, for room to raise contributions.

reviewProgress.title: Check progress each month
reviewProgress.description: Compare each month's contribution with the plan and adjust early if it falls behind.
